claim: Dependency-bound evidence invalidation can establish loss of justified reliance before downstream failure becomes observable, with materially less false invalidation than indiscriminate change monitoring.
standing_loss_definition: t_resolved when dependency-bound reverification completes with LOST; reopening time is not standing-loss time
ttl_dominance_rule: NO_STANDING_LOSS_ADVANTAGE if TTL median lead is at least OLP median lead and TTL false-invalidation rate is no higher than OLP
verdict_rule: ADVANTAGE requires data sufficiency, positive preregistered median lead on declared consequential cases, early resolution in at least the preregistered fraction, OLP false-invalidation rate <= preregistered ratio times Naive Diff, and no TTL Pareto dominance. Otherwise NO_ADVANTAGE.
